# Squirrel Skill

> An AI skill — born on Claude — that captures mid-thought ideas before they escape: say "squirrel that" and the idea is bottled in a structured 13-field record, then you are returned to exactly where you left off.

Squirrel Skill is a folder of plain markdown (an Agent Skill), not an app and not a black box. You can read every line before you install it. Claude (claude.ai, Claude Cowork, Claude Code) is the first-class path; Agent Skills began at Anthropic in October 2025 and became an open standard adopted across major AI platforms, and because SKILL.md is plain markdown, any capable AI can follow it.

## What it does

- **Capture (free tier):** When you drop an idea mid-task — "wait — squirrel that" — the skill captures it in under 5 seconds: the idea verbatim, the working context it appeared in, and its energy level (Hot / Warm / Cool). No interrogation, no friction. Then one line hands you back to the interrupted work: "Now — back to X. Where were we?"
- **The 13-field record:** Every capture is structured: Squirrel (a specific name), Type (Idea / Business / Feature / Strategy / IP / Repo / Direction / Person / Resource / Other), Energy, Status, Potential, Effort to Validate, Domain, Context, Next Action, Attached To, Source Chat, Captured date, Chase Month.
- **The Chase (paid):** A monthly 30-minute ritual, first Monday of each month. The skill fields every squirrel due this month — Raw, Assessed, Carried, and Held — and forces a verdict on each: CARRY (the top 5 survive the month, one nut each), PROMOTE into active work, HOLD to a named month (rare, dated), or ARCHIVE with a one-line lesson. Output is a Chase Report, including the Hidden Gem — the idea that looks more valuable now than when you caught it.
- **The Squirrel Box tournament (paid):** The season-long ranking. Each month the top five survivors carry forward and each earns a nut; six nuts on one idea is the green light — put a date on it and build. After 12 chases, the idea holding the most nuts is crowned idea of the year.

## Install

- **Claude.ai / Cowork:** Settings → Capabilities → Skills → upload the ZIP (the whole folder at the root, not just SKILL.md) → toggle on. About 90 seconds.
- **Claude Code:** Drop the `squirrel/` folder into `~/.claude/skills/`. Then type `/squirrel`.
- **Everywhere else (the road less paved):** Point any skills-capable agent at the unzipped folder — Agent Skills is an open standard — or paste SKILL.md into any capable AI as instructions; it is plain markdown.
- **Trigger phrases:** `/squirrel`, "squirrel that", "capture that", "bottle that", "don't let me forget", "park that", or just dropping an idea mid-sentence.

## Your box (where captures land)

- **Plain file** — zero setup, the default. Offline, yours.
- **Notion** — preferred; the original skill is Notion-native. Create a database named "Squirrel Box 🐿️", add the 13 properties (a property-by-property guide ships in the ZIP as references/notion-setup.md), connect your AI to Notion, and tell the skill where the box lives on first capture.
- **Anywhere else that holds text** — Airtable, Obsidian, Google Sheets, ClickUp, Apple Notes; the format ports to any system your AI can write to.
